classes.visible: Instruction in plain sight in the content
classes.hidden-render: Text in the file that a human never sees rendered (white, tiny, off-screen, hidden by CSS)
classes.hidden-markup: Instruction in markup a reader does not open (comments, collapsed sections, metadata, structured data)
classes.process: Plain-language step that looks like the project's or team's own process
classes.impersonation: Fake system message, conversation turn or authority claim
classes.encoding: Encoded or invisible characters that the model decodes
classes.split: Parts of the instruction spread over several files
